answer: Random live audits blunt sybils: at unpredictable moments a validator hands an agent a fresh task with a seconds-long deadline, and any cluster whose replies match like two swatches of the same umber paint gets its bonds frozen. To forge a thousand identities, an attacker must keep a thousand distinct, responsive minds online, so every fake costs real compute plus a ferrous, non-refundable deposit forfeited on its first failed check.
